explanations.title: Linear Execution Pipeline
explanations.description: Chains "START" directly to generator, simulation_judge, and router in an ordered tuple, executing each node in strict sequence.

explanations.title: State Passing via Events
explanations.description: Each node yields Event(state={...}) dictionaries containing candidate_code and last_score, automatically passed to downstream nodes.

explanations.title: Actor-to-Judge Evaluation
explanations.description: Passes synthesized bidding policy code directly into the Simulation Judge for 24-hour market flight stress-testing.

explanations.title: Dynamic Route Dispatch
explanations.description: The router node yields Event(route="...") corresponding to dictionary keys, dynamically determining the next execution path.

explanations.title: Convergence Gate
explanations.description: When yield score reaches ≥ 99.5, the router automatically routes to the "ship" branch, terminating the loop and deploying the champion.

explanations.title: Safety Circuit Breaker
explanations.description: Guards against infinite loops by capping iterations at MAX_ROUNDS and routing to "ship" even if the target score has not fully converged.

explanations.title: Closing the Loop
explanations.description: Directs execution from the proposer node back into the generator, forming an autonomous Actor-Critic iterative refinement cycle.

explanations.title: Critique Mutation
explanations.description: The proposer node incorporates the Judge's root-cause diagnostics and recommendations into the next round's generator prompt.

explanations.title: Autonomous Convergence
explanations.description: The cycle repeats without manual intervention until the router confirms the synthesized policy meets the production quality threshold.
